consumption.warn: The United States is converted from EIA's barrels per day at 11.60 barrels per tonne (Atlas conversion): EIA's tonnes for the country are missing from 2022 and out of line with its barrels per day in 2021, and its world total in tonnes leaves the country out; the world total here puts it back.
